units.source_text: [\[19\]](#part1335.html#w19) 五月初七从左右马寮牵出白马二十一匹，供天皇观赏后，

en.t: On the seventh day of the fifth month, twenty-one white horses were led out from the Left and Right Stables and presented for the Emperor's viewing; afterward,

units.source_text: 在宫中游行，称之谓“白马节会”。

en.t: they were paraded through the palace, in what was called the White Horse Festival.

units.source_text: 时人相信新年见白马，可以驱邪。

en.t: People at the time believed that seeing white horses in the New Year could drive away evil spirits.
